To write a good prompt for AI: 1) Define a clear Role (e.g. Senior Copywriter), 2) Provide Context, 3) Specify the Task, 4) Set Constraints (length, tone, style), and 5) Declare the exact Output Format (Markdown headers, XML, JSON, bullet points). To write a prompt for an AI video generator (like Sora, Runway Gen-2, or Pika): 1) Describe the core subject and setting, 2) Specify camera dynamics (pan, tilt, zoom, drone shot), 3) Define lighting and mood (golden hour, volumetric glow), and 4) Detail movement pacing and frame rate expectations.
